name: Jeweled Electrum Spork

source.note: Crypt 28 (Bascal Ofenheiss) in the book; ours: a chef's tool of electrum set with small garnets.

summary: A spoon with a fork's ambitions, in electrum and garnets. A curio worth 250 gp.
text: A spoon that is also a fork, cast in electrum and set with seven small garnets. It is absurd, and it is solid, and someone will pay for it.
